UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated creator profile metadata without sensitive PII.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Public display name shown on created quizzes.

photoURL.description: Avatar image URL from Google Auth.

Quiz.title: Quiz
Quiz.description: A user-created quiz with cover, timer, shuffle option, and multiple-choice questions.

title.description: Title of the quiz shown below its cover in the home menu.

description.description: Optional summary or instructions for participants.

coverImage.description: Cover image path, HTTPS URL, or compressed data URL (<= 260KB).

timeLimitMinutes.description: Time limit in minutes (0 means unlimited, max 180).

shuffleQuestions.description: Whether question order is randomized for participants.

questions.description: Bounded array of 1 to 50 multiple-choice questions.

questionCount.description: Total number of questions in the quiz (1 to 50).

authorId.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the quiz creator.

/users/{userId}.description: Private creator profile document isolated to its owner.

/quizzes/{quizId}.description: Quizzes created by signed-in Google users. Single documents are readable via direct link without login; listing and mutations are restricted to the owner.
